newsitem.title: UK: UK's Torex sets rights to buy two firms.
newsitem.headline: UK's Torex sets rights to buy two firms.

text.p: British computer rental firm Torex Group Plc said on Thursday it planned to raise 1.93 million stg through a rights issue to buy two computer companies.
Torex also said its profits before tax for the year ending December 31 would not be less than 1.42 million stg.
The company proposed a two-for-nine placing and open offer of 5.3 million new shares at 43p each.

The money would be used to buy BIT Group, a retail solutions company, for 3.5 million stg, and Ambridge Business Systems Ltd, a medical systems firm, for 1.75 million stg, the company said in a statement.
It said the balance of the payment would either be met from new bank loans or the issue of new ordinary shares with a maximum value of 2.25 million stg.
In addition, the firm said it had bought computer software and hardware distributor Warwick BePoS Group Ltd for 500,000 stg.
